title: Creative catalogue: forty visual styles
status_note: The following banks were materialized from the 10 October 2026 catalogue and are preserved here as usable text. They remain proposals. The catalogue's earlier statement that a second film was in progress and that zero twelve-style slots were qualified is a historical assembly snapshot; it is not today's completed-film ledger. This guide does not retroactively mark individual catalogue recipes rendered because a similarly named film exists.

records.visual_language: Expressive line characters on a rich original setting.
records.value: Strong silhouette and readable intent.
records.check: Keep joints coherent and feet grounded.

records.visual_language: Layered paper forms, visible fibers and restrained shadows.
records.value: Makes grouping and cause easy to separate.
records.check: Avoid false depth claims; inspect cutout edges.

records.visual_language: Dark textured board with precise staged strokes.
records.value: Reveals reasoning in the order it is explained.
records.check: Texture must not reduce label contrast.

records.visual_language: Neutral materials, numbered parts and consistent perspective.
records.value: Clarifies assembly and relationships.
records.check: Verify labels, scale and separation directions.

records.visual_language: Original wood-grain objects and toy-scale scenery.
records.value: Turns abstract systems into tangible spatial relationships.
records.check: Keep texture, scale and contact shadows consistent.

records.visual_language: Soft sculpted forms with intentional hand-made variation.
records.value: Makes effort and personality readable through deformation.
records.check: Do not imply physical stop-motion capture.

records.visual_language: Plush surfaces with stitched boundaries and soft lighting.
records.value: Friendly tactile characters for warm stories.
records.check: Avoid excessive fibers that obscure eyes and joints.

records.visual_language: Glazed figures on a restrained physical stage.
records.value: Highlights fragility, care and deliberate movement.
records.check: Control specular highlights and avoid unreadable white-on-white.

records.visual_language: Cutaway walls and measured spaces.
records.value: Explains hidden interior relationships.
records.check: Keep the cutaway plane honest and distinct from a real inspection.

records.visual_language: Sketches, short annotations and observed-detail inserts.
records.value: Shows curiosity and provisional learning.
records.check: Label illustrations and unresolved facts explicitly.

records.visual_language: Clear geometry and sparse units on a quiet field.
records.value: Supports precise mechanisms without visual clutter.
records.check: Mark idealizations and do not fake measurement precision.

records.visual_language: A measured drawing becomes a matching modeled object.
records.value: Connects intent, geometry and result.
records.check: Only claim exact correspondence after verification.

records.visual_language: Thin lit edges describe original spatial forms.
records.value: Reveals connectivity and motion paths.
records.check: Do not let bloom hide intersections.

records.visual_language: Original stems, leaves and clean anatomical labels.
records.value: Makes growth and structure readable.
records.check: Species-specific claims require sourced references.

records.visual_language: Stacked contour layers and a simple route marker.
records.value: Communicates slope and elevation through layers.
records.check: Label fictional terrain or verify elevation data.

records.visual_language: Original artifacts staged with careful light and a quiet camera.
records.value: Invites close observation and object storytelling.
records.check: Avoid implying fabricated props are authentic artifacts.

records.visual_language: Simple arrows, panels and warm print-like texture.
records.value: Turns a procedure into distinct, memorable checkpoints.
records.check: Use current verified steps; nostalgia is only surface treatment.

records.visual_language: Original illustrated panels with restrained parallax and acting.
records.value: Supports dialogue and clear scene transitions.
records.check: Keep reading order and character identity consistent.

records.visual_language: Strong foreground silhouettes with luminous depth.
records.value: Makes action understandable with minimal detail.
records.check: Do not hide essential physical evidence in shadow.

records.visual_language: Layered scenery inside a visible miniature stage.
records.value: Makes framing and occlusion part of the story.
records.check: Depth is approximate unless built as true 3D.

records.visual_language: Bold shapes, limited hatching and evidence inserts.
records.value: Combines dramatic stakes with readable explanation.
records.check: Preserve factual distinctions despite dramatic styling.

records.visual_language: Soft original washes behind crisp foreground action.
records.value: Creates atmosphere while the mechanism remains sharp.
records.check: Do not wash out important text or targets.

records.visual_language: Orthographic benches, objects and workers.
records.value: Shows parallel operations in one readable space.
records.check: Check occlusion and avoid claiming true scale from decorative isometry.

records.visual_language: Faceted original terrain and restrained material palette.
records.value: Supports routes and spatial decisions efficiently.
records.check: Use honest stylization rather than simulated documentary claims.

records.visual_language: Discrete designed poses with smooth camera motion.
records.value: Highlights tactile decisions and comedic timing.
records.check: Do not claim real frame-by-frame photography.

records.visual_language: Articulated geometric actors with coordinated movement.
records.value: Makes rhythm and interaction the narrative.
records.check: Use original or cleared music; vary choreography materially.

records.visual_language: Clear shells, tinted interior parts and controlled refraction.
records.value: Exposes nested mechanisms while preserving the object silhouette.
records.check: Transparency can hide contacts; add readable edge cues.

records.visual_language: One hue family with distinct roughness and lighting.
records.value: Directs attention to form and surface behavior.
records.check: A palette change alone is not a new story or capability.

records.visual_language: Original diagrams over cleared real-world imagery.
records.value: Connects explanation to a concrete setting.
records.check: Keep image rights and source dates; illustration is not event footage.

records.visual_language: Quantities represented by measured original 3D elements.
records.value: Makes size comparisons physically legible.
records.check: Use proportional encodings and visible units.

records.visual_language: Original pixel characters and deliberate tiled scenery.
records.value: Creates readable game-like rules and compact action.
records.check: Avoid copying recognizable commercial sprites or interfaces.

records.visual_language: Original gears, polished fittings and warm practical lights.
records.value: Gives linked movement a crafted, inspectable feel.
records.check: Decorative gears must not pretend to explain real mechanics.

records.visual_language: Layered aquatic shapes and slow particulate depth.
records.value: Supports calm observation and environmental storytelling.
records.check: Label fantasy biology and keep targets distinct from particles.

records.visual_language: Rich original scene, grounded characters and localized lantern light.
records.value: Creates warmth through depth, contact and shared action.
records.check: Keep dark details readable and avoid flashing highlights.

records.visual_language: Offset texture and bold printed shapes.
records.value: Gives simple comparisons an authored graphic identity.
records.check: Misregistration must not distort evidence or tiny text.

records.visual_language: A clean diagram alternates with a tangible original prop.
records.value: Links symbolic understanding to spatial intuition.
records.check: Keep identity and geometry matched across representations.

records.visual_language: Very close views of original everyday-scale surfaces.
records.value: Turns small choices into legible visual stakes.
records.check: Establish scale and preserve consistent material behavior.

records.visual_language: Cleared background imagery with original animated performers.
records.value: Combines rich setting with explicit character animation.
records.check: Inspect masks, contact shadows and disocclusion; label compositing.

records.visual_language: Matched objects under controlled camera and lighting.
records.value: Makes a single design difference easy to judge.
records.check: Record the variable that changed and what stayed fixed.

records.visual_language: A real or original scene with selectively animated annotations.
records.value: Focuses attention without replacing the scene.
records.check: Annotations must track the same object across motion.
